design.question: Does an actual skipped optional refinement preserve every continuous recurrence and bounded attention-cache update, and is there a measured wall-clock/quality benefit vs equal-budget random gating?
design.gate: Fixed >0.10 current observed sensor-channel variance; only per-event whole fixed batch, no top-k or future outcome
design.negative: Random gate same skip budget, same core/weights/cache/observations
design.fixture: Public continuous sensor/action/dt; 3 untrained initializations 613,617,619; 64 events, batch 4; 3 wall-clock repetitions
design.claims: A skipped MLP is actual compute bypass; only its linear MAC estimate is counted as avoidable. CPU timings are not GPU timings.
design.mandatory_state: Every event advances recurrent state and bounded attention cache even if optional MLP is skipped; all arms must have identical final recurrence/cache
design.acceptance: Engineering integrity PASS regardless of prospective runtime/quality losses; retain full nulls.
design.run_GPU: Only if qualified existing CUDA environment is available; CPU torch does not qualify a CUDA run.
